Also "挪用资金罪" (Article 384?). Also "职务侵占罪" (Article 382). Which applies? The conduct: granting loans to non-eligible persons using false identities, and also misusing funds for personal business. That is illegal loan issuance and embezzlement (misappropriation). So list both crimes: "非法发放贷款" and "挪用资金". According to correction rule: list only statutory offense name without appending “罪”. So we output "非法发放贷款;挪用资金". JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
